context_image.usage_description: Top three are actual Tibia reference costumes and pixel craft. Bottom is the immutable target Citizen pose. Adopt craft and costume richness, not reference weapons, poses or identical outfit.

description: RUNE SENTINEL: a premium ancient guard with a distinctive angular silver-and-dark-steel OPEN-FACE helmet and THREE short swept crown fins; paired sculpted steel shoulder caps, broad layered breastplate framing ONE large teal square chest stone, deep blue short tabard over dark fitted trousers, steel bracers and tall armored boots. Knight/Warrior/Champion material richness, original compact design. Strong helmet/armor silhouette and readable metal edges, not oversize shoulder wings. No cape strips, pale cuffs or bare extra limbs. Native Tibia 8.60 pixel art for a paid original outfit, not a recolor of the starter. Top context images are REAL Tibia costume/pixel-style references only; the bottom CITIZEN is the exact pose target. Keep his fixed face, eyes, two hands, shoulder-elbow-wrist pose and foot positions unchanged. Exactly TWO arms following those original wrist anchors. No additional skin anywhere in the mask. Clearly separate sleeves/bracers from the existing peach hands with dark cuffs. No pale fleshy sleeve panels. New headgear is allowed only in the masked hair/head margin; never redraw a face inside headgear. Same south-facing oblique camera and roughly 32px body, with modest extra headgear height. Rich deliberate 2-3px clusters, strong silhouette, layered shading like the references, dark outlines and upper-left light. Distinct materials, no noisy confetti or smooth antialiasing. No weapons, shields, pets, detached ornaments, glow, shadows, words, panel borders or extra body parts. Transparent background.
